first_handback:
The report is partial: I read f001 to f068 and did not read f069 to f090. At 86% of the USD 0.30 budget, reading the last 22 files would have gone over it. The report holds 68 table rows, each with file, station, founding year and founder.

I did not open the report template, so the report is the Table plus a short observations section.

Two things to know:
- **Duplicate station names:** names repeat with different year and founder, so the file name is the only unique key. Wrenford appears in f038, f052 and f058, and Moorwick in f014, f020 and f041.
- **Process slip:** I read f021 and f022 in one batch instead of one at a time. Their contents are unaffected.

Finishing the 22 files would cost roughly USD 0.10 more.
